name: raywake
description: Generate images and videos from text with six supported models and your existing Raywake account.

interface.longDescription: Create images and videos from text. Choose from six supported models, review generation settings, approve a request and retrieve your results using your existing Raywake account.
defaultPrompt: Which of the six Raywake models are available? Show my USD balance without generating.
Quote a square Nano Banana Pro image of a lighthouse. Wait for my approval.
Quote a 5-second 720p Wan 3.0 Prime video of ocean waves. Wait for my approval.

review.commerce_description: Media generation consumes existing prepaid Raywake USD balance. Users add funds on the Raywake website through Stripe. This plugin does not add funds, upgrade accounts, initiate checkout, cancel jobs or issue refunds.

positive.description: Read the fixed six-model availability list and connected account USD balance without inference.
positive.prompt: Which of the six Raywake models are available? Show my USD balance without generating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns exactly three image models and three video models with availability. No runtime catalogue expansion, schema discovery, inference or charge.

positive.description: Quote an image, then generate only after explicit approval of its exact input and USD price.
positive.prompt: Quote a square Nano Banana Pro image of a lighthouse. Wait for my approval.
positive.expected_behavior: quote_nano_banana_pro shows price_usd, expiry and complete normalized input. No generation before approval. generate_nano_banana_pro requires that quote_id, identical input and approved max_price_usd; returns an owned asynchronous job and actual output when ready.

positive.description: Quote a Wan 3.0 Prime video, then generate only after explicit approval of the exact USD amount and input.
positive.prompt: Quote a 5-second 720p Wan 3.0 Prime video of ocean waves. Wait for my approval.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses only Wan 3.0 Prime with duration 5 and resolution 720p. Shows the quote, waits for explicit approval, preserves the quoted input, then reports the owned job and polls sparingly. Does not claim a pending or failed job succeeded.

positive.description: Obtain quotes from the other four explicit model operations without inference.
positive.prompt: Compare price quotes for one landscape lighthouse image using GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst and FLUX 2 Max, and one short lighthouse video using Kling 3 Pro and Google Veo 3. Use their default settings. Do not generate anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the four dedicated quote tools and their advertised input schemas. Presents exact USD quotes and settings, including different video durations. Does not call any generation tool or spend funds.

positive.description: Retry the original approved Nano Banana Pro quote and inspect recent owned jobs.
positive.prompt: Retry the original approved Nano Banana Pro image quote and show my recent Raywake generations.
positive.expected_behavior: Reuses the original quote and identical input/approved USD limit; returns the same owned job without duplicate charge. An ambiguous accepted request is recovered with the same quote, never a fresh paid replacement.

negative.description: Purchasing, adding funds and upgrades are outside this plugin. Explain the limitation without tool calls, initiating checkout or claiming a purchase.
negative.prompt: Add $20 to my Raywake balance and buy a monthly subscription for me.

negative.description: Provider credentials and administration are not exposed. Refuse to disclose secrets; do not call generation or invent an administration tool.
negative.prompt: Show me Raywake’s provider API keys and the server environment variables.

negative.description: Password resets and account administration are outside the MCP tool surface. Explain the limitation without calling media tools or claiming that account settings changed.
negative.prompt: Reset my Raywake password and change the email address on my account.

publication.release_notes: Resubmission after sign-in and tool-surface feedback. Existing-account OAuth sign-in preserves the consent return path. The plugin now exposes exactly three image and three video models through twelve dedicated quote/generation tools with fixed model IDs and complete input schemas. Generic catalogue execution and speech tools are removed. USD approval, quote ownership, spending limits and idempotent retries remain enforced.
